scripts.module:generate: pnpm module:build && spacetime generate --yes --lang rust --out-dir crates/client-bindings/src --bin-path target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/dodgeball_server.wasm
scripts.module:publish: pnpm module:build && spacetime publish dodgeball-simulator -s http://localhost:3000 --yes --bin-path target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/dodgeball_server.wasm
scripts.rust:check: cargo check --manifest-path Cargo.toml -p dodgeball-sim -p dodgeball-server -p dodgeball-client -p dodgeball-client-desktop
scripts.rust:check:wasm: cargo check --manifest-path Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p dodgeball-server -p dodgeball-client-web
scripts.check: turbo run typecheck && pnpm rust:test && pnpm rust:check:wasm
